docs: Profile intro content: the name as the heading, the role, a description, a portrait and an ordered list of links (a site, social profiles). One object is valid in every profile layout (the portrait at the end, at the start, above the name).

title.docs: the name of the person (the heading)

description.docs: one paragraph under the heading; empty: none

image.docs: address of the portrait; none: the placeholder

links.docs: the links of the person, in the order they are shown

id.docs: stable key of the entry (the Codex entry id)
